note: What each package channel is serving or being prepared to serve. Publishing is always a deliberate act through the protected distribution workflow; cargo exo-dev release feed-drift reads the feeds and reports, and never publishes anything.

github.note: The GitHub Release is the source every other channel downloads from.

chocolatey.note: The thin package installs the official MSI. The protected distribution workflow submitted 0.10.1; the community repository moderates each version before it appears in the feed.

winget.note: The manifests install the official MSI with the Microsoft.VCRedist.2015+.x64 dependency. The submission pull request is open in microsoft/winget-pkgs.

scoop.note: The official bucket Exoridus/scoop-exosnap installs the pruned portable ZIP; the manifest read back carries the released 0.10.1 URL and its exact hash.
